messages.subject: Null pointer exception at Deducer.java:568
parts:
Hi,

I installed DeducerSpatial according to the instructions at
http://www.r-bloggers.com/open-street-maps/

It seems to work, however R is flooded with errors like this:

java.lang.NullPointerException
at org.rosuda.deducer.Deducer.idleEval(Deducer.java:568)
at
org.rosuda.deducer.data.DataViewerController.refreshData(DataViewerController.java:
208)
at
org.rosuda.deducer.data.DataRefresher.run(DataViewerController.java:
248)
at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:662)

Any tips?

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Null pointer exception at Deducer.java:568
parts:
Are you sure that you have the latest development version of
Deducer/JGR. If you do sessionInfo(), you should see Deducer_0.4-5 and
JGR_1.8-8. DeducerSpatial relies on some new features.

Install with:
install.packages(c("JGR","Deducer"),,"http://rforge.net",type="source")

Ian
